meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Audit codebases in parallel, find vulnerabilities and verify exploitability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep security review of codebases with exploitability validation

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会组织一支 5 人虚拟安全团队——3 名漏洞猎手并行找漏洞，2 名 PoC 工程师独立验证哪些问题真能被利用，再按攻击路径和影响定严重级别，最终给出 PASS、PASS WITH FINDINGS 或 BLOCK 的裁决报告。
howto.when: 当用户说出“security-research”“security review”“vulnerability audit”等触发词，或要求安全审查、漏洞研究、威胁模型验证时触发。前提：团队工具已启用、在主会话；无指定目标时审计当前仓库。

say.text: 用 security-research 审计当前仓库的登录鉴权代码
say.note: 触发并行挖洞与 PoC 验证，输出带证据的裁决报告。

say.text: 对这次 PR 的改动做漏洞可利用性审计

howto.what_en: Claude assembles 3 hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove real exploitability, classify root causes, score severity, and output a PASS / PASS WITH FINDINGS / BLOCK verdict report.
howto.when_en: Triggered by 'security-research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', or any security review request. Needs team tools enabled and main session; audits current repo if no target.

say_en.text: Audit the current repo's login and auth code with security-research.
say_en.note: Launches the parallel team and returns the verdict report.

say_en.text: Run an exploitability audit on this PR's changes.
say_en.note: Hunters review the diff; PoC engineers verify real impact.
